provenance.exclusion: Exploratory smoke seeds 99991 and 99997 tested before source freeze. Their existing outcomes are disclosed separately, never treated as preregistered validation. No primary run before this prereg commit.

hypothesis: Validation-gated sparse Fourier correction should reject harmful new-context updates while preserving the old model; its cold-shift prediction error should improve meaningfully on two unseen seed cohorts over fully trained ElasticNet and ungated sparse correction, with no gain from sham labels.

study_design.negative: new consequences shuffled in corrective-learning control
study_design.sample_parity: All real methods observe identical 72 old and 72 new factual labels; gate uses validation partition 24 of new outcomes before final refit on all 72 new; all held consequences inaccessible during any decision.
study_design.architecture: Authored 12-bit feature dictionary with parity order1..5, 1585 terms. The gate is predictive-error reduction on NEW validation, not an independently identified causal contradiction. Two observed nuisance bits shift old/new/cold contexts. Native model not trained.
study_design.cost: CPU Python3.13.5 NumPy2.3.5 sklearn1.8.0 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. One exact-source 2-seed screen (24 worlds) plus deterministic replay and source-sharing refit audit. No GPU/paid API.
metrics: mean of per-world squared prediction error on old/new/cold disjoint held worlds
relative gain over conventional and ungated controls

frozen_screen_gates.cold_vs_enet_each: Gated energy cold MSE must be ≤95% of fully trained separate-context ElasticNet cold MSE on BOTH prospectively held screen seeds.
frozen_screen_gates.cold_vs_ungated_pooled: Pooled gated energy cold MSE must be ≤97% of ungated energy cold MSE; underperforms if rejects beneficial updates.
frozen_screen_gates.new_vs_enet_pooled: Pooled gated energy new held MSE must be ≤105% of fully trained ElasticNet new held MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.old_checkpoint_exact: Mean old held MSE for gated energy equals no-adaptation old predictor exactly within 1e-10 on EACH seed.
frozen_screen_gates.shuffled_negative_pooled: Pooled gated energy cold held MSE must be ≤80% of shuffled-label gated correction cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.no_adapt_pooled: Pooled gated energy cold held MSE must be ≤90% of old frozen no-adaptation cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.audit: Both independent-seed score receipts and source-sharing refit audits pass; audit reuses the generator and sklearn estimators but re-derives saved losses and interventions.
frozen_screen_gates.meaningful_gate: At least one accepted and one rejected correction across 24 worlds; otherwise gate has not been exercised.

classification.SCREEN_PROMISING: Both independent seeds satisfy cold-vs-ElasticNet and pooled gate-vs-ungated, and at least 6/8 gates PASS, with all audit source gates PASS. Only then eligible for the reserved 36-world primary. This is screening, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification.SCREEN_NO_GO: Both independent seeds are ≥10% WORSE than ElasticNet cold and the pooled gate has no positive >=3% gain over ungated energy, OR ≥4 of 6 quantitative candidate gates FAIL across the two prospective screens. Preserve negative outcomes; no primary scoring/tuning on reserved seeds.
classification.SCREEN_INCONCLUSIVE: All other combinations. Do not claim a positive; preserve results and stop this candidate unless a separately preregistered disjoint experiment is constructed.
classification.INVALID: Any leak of held labels, missing controls, source SHA/protocol drift, missing full audit, mismatched action count, consumed prospective seeds before this commit. Do not label scientific no-go if invalid.
classification.primary_scope: Primary seeds [9419,9431,9449] run only if SCREEN_PROMISING and separately verified source/prereg frozen. No native acceptance or deployment under any outcome.

after_score_prohibitions: No threshold changes or extra tune passes on consumed seeds
No retrospective relabeling of exploratories as prereg
No runner/controller/scheduler/queue changes, merge, deployment or protected first-use
standing_authority: Independent contributor research on draft branch only. Does not authorize native scientific acceptance.
prespec_status: Source commit precedes this prereg; prospective screening seeds were not evaluated as of this commit.
